subject.title: System prompt: add guidance for spawning background sub-agents

question: Should this PR be consolidated into the existing sub-agent prompt/tool-description surfaces, or should maintainers intentionally change nested sub-agent policy?
rationale: The remaining blocker is maintainer prompt-policy direction because current main already has several delegation guidance surfaces and explicitly supports configured nested spawning.

options.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
options.body: Keep only useful examples and merge them into the existing availability-aware and depth-aware prompt surfaces.

options.title: Change Nested Policy Coherently
options.body: If nested spawning should be forbidden, update runtime config, docs, tests, and model-facing guidance together.

options.title: Pause Or Close As Covered
options.body: If current-main guidance is sufficient, leave this stale branch unmerged rather than adding another prompt-policy surface.

recommendation.title: Rebase And Consolidate Guidance
recommendation.body: Keep only useful examples and merge them into the existing availability-aware and depth-aware prompt surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent merged prompt-guidance history point to this owner candidate for the affected prompt surfaces.
